issue.detail: Spec says 'positive edge triggered asynchronous reset' which is contradictory; contract treats as async active high. Alternative: reset is synchronous active high on posedge clk.
issue.spec_evidence: areset is a positive edge triggered asynchronous reset that resets the history counter to zero
issue.alternative: Synchronous reset: history updates to 0 only at posedge clk when areset==1; otherwise normal operation.
